items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we had been pals for a long time

ctx.x: I think that was produced by Ozzie Cadena. He worked for Savoy during the years that I did. He has much the same attitude as Prestige, rather than Blue Note, even though he worked for Blue Note too. Ozzie knew the music, he knew the way the guys wanted to sound, he got them here on time, and he was pretty definite as to what he wanted, sitting in here as a producer. We made some pretty good records. Some of them I didn’t even realize, in retrospect, that Ozzie made them. You think of Savoy, you think of a blues,…
I knew Bob Thiele before he came to run.
